method: GitHub GraphQL default-branch commit, visibility, archive state and license (read-only), recorded as the pin; manifest.json and the digested files are read from the pinned commit object in a local clone. A missing commit object, manifest or API shape is recorded as unclassified with its reason, never inferred from the name or README.
selection: Public and private repositories of the organization named com-*, cloud-* or with a dotted reverse-domain name (the AWAI-59 target set). Private repositories are counted only.

reasons.connector-contract-no-api-manifest: A connector contract (connector.edn) with tools and OAuth scopes but no API-shape manifest. Candidate for an MCP or tool reference after review.
reasons.dataset-snapshot-no-api-manifest: A DataLad dataset of an external API's responses, not an API shape. Candidate for a dataset-source catalog (ADR 0004) after its own review.
reasons.no-api-manifest: No manifest.json at the pinned commit. The README describes a client library, codec, driver or service surface; a README is not parsed into an API shape.
reasons.private-repository: A private repository: counted here, but its name and contents are not published.
